text_block_list.text:
I'm on an outing with Фудзи Кисэки one
day, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! Trainer! Won't you dance a fun
little
dance with me?"

It feels like the voice came from inside a
nearby
claw machine filled with plush
toys...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I really got you there! It was just
me. Did
you like my little trick?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Just look at all the adorable ponies
they've got
here!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I wish I could let them out and bring
them to the
stage, but...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It would take a lot of work to win them...
Gosh,
just what should I do?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She gives me an imploring smile, and I
take her
not-so-subtle hint.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I'll get as many of them as possible!

text_block_list.text:
There may be consequences if you don't
get any,
so do your best!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
